 CALL TO ORDER

 At 3:37 PM, Councilwoman Thrash-Ntuk called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Councilmembers Present: Zendejas, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Thrash-Ntuk, Ricks-Oddie

 Councilmembers Absent: Allen, Duggan, Supernaw

 Also present: Ashleigh Stone, Deputy City Attorney, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54845  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City of Long Beach as the
  Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency of the City of Long Beach
  meeting of Tuesday, January 7, 2025.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Ricks-Oddie, seconded by
  Councilwoman Kerr, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  6  Zendejas, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Thrash-Ntuk, Ricks-Oddie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Allen, Duggan, Supernaw

  of City-owned surplus property located at 1827 Pacific Avenue (Assessor's Parcel
